title: 2224. Finding the Average of Two Numbers Using a Function
description:
Submissions
2224
. 
Finding the Average of Two Numbers Using a Function
30
Easy
Problem Statement
Read two integers and print their average with two decimal places, using a function that returns a float.
Description
Read two integers a and b from input. Write a function averageOfTwo that takes two integer parameters and returns their average as a float. Divide the sum by 2.0 (and not by 2) inside the function, so that the decimal part of the average is not lost. Call the function from main() and print the returned value with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
Input Description
Two integers a and b separated by a space.
Output Description
Print the average of a and b with two digits after the decimal point.
Sample Input
7 10
Sample Output
8.50
